screen_level_effect.definition: |S_h| >= 0.01 decade AND |S_h| > max(0.005 decade, 5x numerical/action bound)

response_classes.REBONDING_RATE_OFFSET_LIKE: max_K S_h - min_K S_h magnitude <0.01 decade AND |Delta m| <0.25
response_classes.REBONDING_STEEPENS_RESPONSE: Delta m >= 0.25, same sign across required seeds
response_classes.REBONDING_FLATTENS_RESPONSE: Delta m <= -0.25, same sign across required seeds
response_classes.REBONDING_CURVED_ONSET_OR_CROSSOVER: adjacent secants differ by >=0.50 or change substantially across the K grid while net response is monotone
response_classes.REBONDING_SEED_SENSITIVE: seed slope signs disagree or |Delta m_seed1 - Delta m_seed2| > 0.25

axis_sensitivity_gate: at least 0.01 decade in S_h or 0.25 in Delta m, AND larger than max(0.005 decade, 5x propagated numerical/action uncertainty)

static_dynamic_attribution.MIXED_STATIC_SHIELDING_AND_KINETIC_HISTO: max|S_dynamic-S_static|<=0.03 decade OR |delta_m_dynamic-delta_m_static|<=0.25, dominant gate fails
